title: net2 gate, round 7e: round 7's students at teacher gain 0.5 as one ensemble with the veto
description: Round 7's gate3 students with q vetoing the push met every gate condition but copies at teacher gain 1 (exp-net2-gate-r7v-128: copies -0.145; at q's threshold 0, exp-net2-gate-r7vq0-131, -0.142). Per link, that loss came from single seeds: in 12 of the 42 pairs of link and number of copies one seed lost 0.5 or more to the rule, in none did all three, and those cells carry 72% of the loss. Here the three seeds at teacher gain 0.5 (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124) run as one policy whose beliefs are the mean of theirs (experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py, recurrent.EnsembleActor), so one seed's misfire is diluted by the others, with the veto (gate3_copies "rule"), p's threshold at 0.5 and q's at 0, the setting fixed before this gate ran. Teacher gains 1 and 0.5 each get their own gate because the rule keeps the best five-family mean, which leaves copies out. Its policy is in release model-net2-r7e05-cands (named seed 0, the ensemble of seeds 1 to 3). They run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21. The share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 on net1 v5 also runs, as a reference and not a candidate: it is what the teacher does wherever a stock TCP flow is active, so with the fixed rule it bounds what the student can reach. The rule is unchanged (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions, each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. A candidate that passes runs once on the test links. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
